action_items: REVIEW ITEM 1 (Attendance segment Reject button regression FIXED): PASS. All 8 flagged cards show BOTH testID att-reject-<id> (red 'Reject') AND testID att-approve-<id> (green 'Approve') side by side. Enumerated in DOM: 8 cards ⇒ 8 rejects ⇒ 8 approves, perfectly paired. Confirmed in approvals.tsx:528-547 (both BigButton renders with matching testIDs, flex:1 layout). Regression from v1.0.14 is fully resolved.

REVIEW ITEM 2 (New i18n reason keys wired): PASS. English chip 'Beacon not detected — GPS only' rendered 5x for the 5 no_beacon_gps_only rows currently in TIME_OFFICE Attendance list. Marathi chip 'बीकन आढळला नाही — फक्त GPS' rendered 3x after switching to Marathi via profile-lang-mr (some optimistic-removed rows differ). Marathi chip 'बीकन नाही व GPS नाही' (att.reasonNoBeaconNoGps) also visible for the one no_beacon_no_gps row (D013). Zero raw-key leaks: page.locator('text=att.reasonNoBeacon').count() = 0.

REVIEW ITEM 3 (Reject action + optimistic remove + APPROVE regression): PASS. Tapped att-reject-<id> on first card ⇒ card removed from DOM (before=1, after=0), zero error toasts. Tapped att-approve-<id> on the next card ⇒ card removed (after=0). Both call the correct endpoints (rejectAttendance ⇒ POST /api/attendance/{id}/reject; approveAttendance ⇒ POST /api/attendance/{id}/approve — verified in endpoints.ts:187-191).

REVIEW ITEM 4 (Marathi language switch): PASS. profile-lang-mr chip successfully switches the app to Marathi (Approvals screen header reads 'मंजुऱ्या', tab-bar labels होम/विभाग/तक्रारी/मंजुऱ्या/सूचना/प्रोफाइल, reason chips render as Marathi text). No att.reasonNoBeacon raw-key leak anywhere.

REVIEW ITEM 5 (Incident capture regression on web — expected zone-chip absence): PASS. /incident/capture opens without crash and shows the standard camera-permission gate (no red screen, no blank). testID='zone-chip' count on web = 0, matching the v1.0.15 contract (BleScanner.isReal is false on web ⇒ background scan early-exits ⇒ setBleZone never called ⇒ chip is conditionally not rendered). Screenshot confirms Marathi camera-permission screen with 'कॅमेरा हवा' button — the incident screen is functional. GPS chip and full submit flow cannot be exercised on headless web (browser context has no camera), same as iter18.

REVIEW ITEM 6 (Home/Reports regression + console health): PASS. /home and /reports both render (Marathi tab-bar screenshot proves layout intact after the language flip). Zero console errors captured during the whole run; zero beaconRegistry-specific console errors (checked case-insensitively for beaconRegistry/beacon_registry/beaconregistry substrings).

ENV RESTORE VERIFIED: /app/frontend/.env now has EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://api.hogoplus.in (restored at end of run). Expo restarted after both flip and restore. GET /api/admin/settings final poll returns beacon_first_mode=False. Sandbox is safe.

Contract with web preview matches the reviewer note. Code PASS.

capture.tsx:484-488 — zone-chip is rendered ONLY when bleZone is truthy; uses testID='zone-chip' as specified. No web crash even when bleHitRef is null (submit passes beacon fields via beaconPayload(null) which returns empty spread). Code PASS.
